title: Settings
displayNameNote: Friends and people you share with see this name.
passwordNote: Change it with a code sent to your email.
signOutEverywhereNote: Ends every session of this account, including this one.
appearanceNote: Appearance is kept on this browser. The Theme entry in the rail holds the same choices.
usernameNote: Chosen at sign-up; it cannot be changed. Your code and your profile link use it.
byUsernameNote: Always. @{username} is how friends find you and what your code says.
byEmailNote: Someone who types {email} sees you. Off, they see nothing.
byEmailNoteNone: This account has no email to be found by.
othersChangesNote: On the page you are viewing
